purpose: Promote recoverable Wave-5/G2 TIM close and handoff semantics into a forward-only R7 contract, resolve the remaining receipt, outcome, projection and event binding gaps, and prohibit the Time module from inventing public transport or cross-service semantics.
provenBlockers: The five public close and handoff paths are absent from the current Time OpenAPI.
The three TIM typed events are absent from the current AsyncAPI.
The v49 handoff GET response binding cannot express handoff state or receiver receipt.
The only public command receipt mapping and DTO are Timecard-specific.
The historical transport is not in the R7 token DAG and conflicts with current step-up, ETag and runtime event-key conventions.
IAQ-039, IAQ-043 and IAQ-044 lack valid current generated projections.
PAY durable closed-time ingestion has no migration lease and remains a separate owner gate.

postHeaders.ifMatch: single strong numeric ETag matching ^"[0-9]+"$ and representing close-period aggregate version

precondition.versionMismatch: 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED with currentVersion and current ETag

receiptSeal.existingTimecardDto: TimeCommandReceiptV1 remains byte-compatible and is never converted to oneOf.
receiptSeal.lookupDto: TimeCommandReceiptLookupV1 is the only oneOf of TimeCommandReceiptV1 and TimeCloseCommandReceiptV1.

singleRouteOwner.rule: A central provider registry asks every tenant-scoped provider for ownership; zero successful owners is opaque 404 only after every provider completed successfully, one owner revalidates sealed originating authority, multiple owners is audited 503, and any provider lookup error, timeout or unavailability is audited 503 fail-closed rather than treated as zero owners; first-provider-wins is forbidden.

receiptSeal.resultUnknown: Once a durable receipt is reserved, uncertain processing is represented by receipt status RESULT_UNKNOWN rather than an untracked raw 503.

idempotencyAndApproval.sameDigest: Return the original persisted 202 body and receipt without a second mutation or outbox row.

separationOfDuties: close maker differs from approval actor
reopen actor differs from original closer
reopen correction maker differs from close approver
approval.reason: reopen request reasonCode equals canonical PDX-011 reasonCode; close approval reason is null

publicStatusDto.name: PayrollTimeHandoffStatusV1
publicStatusDto.version: starts at 1 and increases for every accepted outcome transition

stateInvariants.PENDING: receiverReceiptId, receiverReceiptRevision, receiverReceiptDigest, reasonCode and outcomeAt are null
stateInvariants.ACKNOWLEDGED: receiverReceiptId, receiverReceiptRevision, receiverReceiptDigest and outcomeAt are non-null; reasonCode is null
stateInvariants.REJECTED: receiverReceiptId, receiverReceiptRevision, receiverReceiptDigest, reasonCode and outcomeAt are non-null
stateInvariants.RESULT_UNKNOWN: receiverReceiptId, receiverReceiptRevision, receiverReceiptDigest, reasonCode and outcomeAt are non-null

requiredHeaders.X-Correlation-ID: single canonical lowercase UUID equal to body correlationId

constraints.reasonCode: null only for ACKNOWLEDGED; non-null uppercase ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9._-]{0,79}$ for REJECTED and RESULT_UNKNOWN
constraints.outcomeAt: non-null RFC3339 UTC instant normalized with Z
constraints.correlationId: canonical lowercase UUID and equal to the request X-Correlation-ID

trust: TLS1.3 mTLS whose SPIFFE SAN maps to workload dwp-payroll-server
no browser, user, tenant or forwarded override headers
proofBinding: path is the canonical path with the exact lowercase handoffId and no query or trailing alias
requestBodySha256 is the lowercase SHA-256 of the exact received UTF-8 body bytes
certificate SPIFFE SAN maps to workload dwp-payroll-server and independently X-DWP-Service-Identity, iss and sub are each exactly dwp-payroll-server
iat equals nbf, exp is after iat, exp minus iat is at most 30 seconds and the proof is currently valid
jti and requestNonce are distinct canonical lowercase UUIDs
authn is exactly [MTLS_SPIFFE,CLIENT_CREDENTIAL_JWT] and is re-derived from the verified certificate and registered kid profile rather than trusted from the claim
tenantTrust: tenantId is a positive signed owner tenant and comes only from the verified proof
the Time owner revalidates its current tenant grant authorizing dwp-payroll-server for the signed tenant
signed tenantGrantRevision and policyRevision each exactly equal the Time owner's current revalidated revisions
internalOutcome.replay: jti and requestNonce are durable single-use within the proof validity window; an exact business-outcome retry is handled only by the receiver receipt id/revision/digest rule after a fresh valid proof; reused proof material is denied.
deny: additional, missing or duplicate proof claims
wrong service, audience, tenant, body digest, binding, purpose, method or path

errorProfile.body: HrisTimeProblemV1 with only type, title, status, code, correlationId and retryable; detail, fieldErrors, tenantId, handoffId and target-derived values are forbidden

400.when: strict JSON, additionalProperties, required/nullability/format constraint, path parameter, X-Correlation-ID or body/header correlation validation fails

401.when: missing, malformed, unverifiable or expired workload proof, reused jti or requestNonce, or missing/invalid mTLS

403.when: verified caller has wrong audience, binding, purpose, method, path, grant, tenantGrantRevision or policyRevision

404.when: tenant or target mismatch using one constant opaque representation

409.when: outcome transition, outcomeCommandDigest or receiver revision conflict; quarantine and audit required

503.when: trust, grant, replay-store, provider or dependency authority is unavailable; Retry-After required

errorProfile.headers: Cache-Control: no-store and X-Correlation-ID are required on every error; when the request X-Correlation-ID is absent or invalid the owner generates one canonical lowercase UUID and uses it identically in the response header and problem body; Retry-After is additionally required on 429 and 503
errorProfile.nonDisclosure: Every error body uses a constant title for its status and omits handoff existence and all target-derived data.

transitions: RESULT_UNKNOWN -> ACKNOWLEDGED|REJECTED with same receiverReceiptId and exact next revision
internalOutcome.idempotency: The outcomeCommandDigest is SHA-256 over RFC8785 canonical JSON containing tenantId, lowercase handoffId, closedTimeResultId, closeRevision, payloadDigest, outcome, receiverReceiptId, receiverReceiptRevision, receiverReceiptDigest, reasonCode, outcomeAt and correlationId. The same tenant/handoff/receiverReceiptId/revision and outcomeCommandDigest replays the original 200; any semantic change, digest conflict or revision gap is 409 plus quarantine and audit.
internalOutcome.success: 200 PayrollTimeHandoffStatusV1 with Cache-Control: no-store and strong numeric ETag matching the returned version
internalOutcome.writer: Only Time writes handoff state; no fourth AsyncAPI event is introduced.

common: mutation receipt terminal update and outbox insert in one transaction
exact retry reuses event and outbox row
